facts.text: Serve the snacks when Aladdin runs through the Agrabah market with the bread.
facts.why: In the 2019 film Aladdin doesn't steal bread. Abu takes Jasmine's bracelet, and Aladdin trades a necklace for dates for a hungry kid while they run from the guards. Bread is the 1992 film.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Aladdin and Jasmine run through the Agrabah market with the guards behind them.

facts.text: Steal the bread. Share the plate.
facts.why: Same slip as the cue: the bread is from the 1992 film. In 2019 the market scene is about the bracelet and the dates.
facts.fix: Run the market. Share the plate.

facts.why: The page read has Abu stealing Jasmine's bracelet in the market, and the ruby in the Cave of Wonders. It describes no fruit.

facts.text: Seventy five golden camels, one golden pastry.
facts.why: Prince Ali's entrance is real, but the pages read don't give the camel count for the 2019 film.
facts.fix: A parade for Prince Ali, one golden pastry.

vibe.verdict: An elegant palace banquet with good dishes, but the bread line comes from the 1992 film and the 2019 moments are thin.
missing: 'Get your own jams!' (Genie, when Aladdin asks him for snacks)
Prince Ali's grand arrival (the parade into Agrabah)
The magic carpet ride (Aladdin and Jasmine)
Jafar's cobra staff being destroyed (the palace)
'Only the diamond in the rough' can enter the cave (Jafar's plan)
Genie and Dalia, the new couple
ideas: Swap the Genie's note for his real line, 'Get your own jams!', which is about snacks and is much shorter.
Swap 'Abu stealing fruit' in the order of cheers for 'Abu snatching Jasmine's bracelet'.
Swap the 'the golden Cave of Wonders' note under the falafel for 'Only a diamond in the rough gets through'.
Swap 'Camel parking in the rear' on the place card for 'Prince Ali of Ababwa, by invitation'.
